Stipends for External Participants

From the ORA eTraining module "Supporting Participants: Payments, Benefits, and Indirect Costs" (lesson 4 of 9).
Stipend Processing: Students Outside of MSU
Notes for Section
In some cases, it may be appropriate to provide participant support in the form of a stipend to a student who is not enrolled at Morgan State University. This may include, for example, a high school student or a student attending another university. When such payments are allowable under the terms of the sponsored award and align with the purpose of the participant support activity, the request should be processed using the Honoraria Request Memo available on the ORA Post Award Forms page.
Complete the content above before moving on.
DocuSign: External Stipend Required Information
Reminder: Please utilize ORA's DocuSign forms for stipend requests found on the ORA Post-Award Forms page: https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/post-award/forms
Title III Funding
Select 'Yes' or 'No' to identify if this stipend or honoraria request is Title III funded.
School and Department Info
List your School and the Department, Center, or Major Program funding this request.
Contact Lead
Identify the Project Principal Investigator (PI) or Program Director (PD).
Submission Date
Enter the date this document is submitted through DocuSign for approval. Stipend or honoraria checks cannot be issued less than 45 days from this submission date.
Award Title & Funding Period
List the title as written on the project's Notice of Award (NOA). Also, include the month, term, and year for which support is funded by this request.
Grant Codes (FOAPAL)
When an award is established a FOAPAL (fund, org code, account, program, activity, location) string is established that uniquely identifies the award in Banner. Look for an email from the Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) team or send an email to ask.ora@morgan.edu if you do not know this information.
Banner Account Code
Honoraria requests are charged to the Contractual Salaries (02) pool level in Banner (specifically account 02010). Ensure appropriate funding is available in that pool level prior to document submission.
Contact for Questions
Add contact information for any questions related to this request. This may be the PI or designated program manager or admin.
School Address & Contact Number
Please include the School, Mailing Address, and Contact Number for your department.
Candidate Name
Enter the stipend/honoraria recipient's full legal name.
MSU ID and SSN
Each student should have an active MSU ID and Social Security Number (SSN) to be paid by the State of Maryland. Individuals without a SSN will need to work with the Office of International Affairs to receive one.
Mailing Address
List the address to where stipend checks should be mailed. Morgan State should not be used as a recipient's mailing address for stipend checks.
Stipend Amount
Include the amount to be paid to each individual in this column. Be sure stipend amounts listed are allocable to the project's scope and allowable under the project's Notice of Award and sponsor/program guidelines.
Check Issue Date
Check Issue Dates MUST be more than 45 days after the DocuSign submission date. This is the date by which the State of Maryland should authorize payment of the outlined requests. Physical payments can take up to 5 business days beyond the check issue date to be received by the payee. Direct deposit payments are generally faster.

International Participant Stipend Requests
For international participants, the State of Maryland requires a completed GADX-9 Form (below) to process a wire transfer. Please ensure: (1) all information is typed (2) the form is completed entirely (3) no form fields are altered (4) banking information is 100% accurate. Incomplete or incorrect information may lead in errors resulting in lost funds. Questions regarding direct deposit setup should be forwarded to the State Comptroller's Office/GAD at GAD@comp.state.md.us .
